title: Gradual changes to the present band
summary: New players like Jimmy Forrest and Butch Miles came gradually, and the loss of Marshall Royal was felt.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: Well, let's just speak of the fact -- let's talk about -- we were really speaking about how around the present band -- what changes there were that brought about this present band. I asked when Jimmy Ferrest joined the band, and you said about four years ago.
Mm hmm.
And, Butch came into the band about, like, two and a half years ago.
Two and a half years ago.
These changes have been kind of gradual. I mean, it hasn't been a big upset in the band?
No. No. The changes have been gradual.
When Marshall left the band, that must have been a
change to the band, wasn't it?
It was a change, yeah, because we missed him.
Yeah.
We missed him.
Did Bobby Plater become Straw Koss?
Yeah. Bobby came in, and he took over, and handled it well.
And, handled it well?
Yeah. But, you know, all in all, down through the years, more or less, the band is basically the same, you know.
The way it's been?
The way -- yeah. It's basically the same. But, I would say that it was good, and it's still good. And, you know, down through the years, with all the changes one way or the other ---
It still maintains its character
-- it's still holding up -- you know.

Yeah, but one thing that seems to me different as compared to the old band is that today the soloists are not as important as they used to be. I mean I think what really scores more today are those ensembles.

Well, the ensembles are a headline as far as the band is today, like years ago it used to be the soloists. But, the band -- the present band now don't really rely too much on the soloists. You're right.
There's no soloist of the stature of Lester Young, or---?

Well, no -- it's a different style altogether. And, the feeling is different as far as the playing is concerned. But, where Jimmy Forrest is concerned, he's making a name for himself now, you know, and Eric Dixon has been tremendous, and as a whole, the whole thing is just about terrific as far as I'm concerned now.
